d: Anant Singh Horse Race : mokama men anant sinh ki beti ki shadi to dhumdham se sanpann ho gaee... lekin shadi ka ek aisa mukabla hai, jiska romanch ab bhi baki hai... maidan men ghore daure, char raund tak jabardast takkar dekhne ko mili, lekin jis phainal res men saphed rang ki chamachmati Thar jitne ka mauka tha, vahi mukabla nahin ho paya... aur ab to jyadatar ghurasvar apne ghore lekar vapas bhi laut chuke hain... aise men sabse bara saval hai ki aakhir Thar kise milegi... kya phainal res ke lie ghurasvaron ko dobara mokama bulaya jaega ya phir is mukable ka koee dusra phaisla…
